text:
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx rate observed for Lucent Financial private deployment (v2). Triggering page to on-call. Affected region: us-west-2. Root cause unknown. @Olivia Chen please acknowledge.
PagerDuty: Paging @Olivia Chen (on-call) — incident PD-7892 created.
Olivia Chen: acked — taking it. Logged into logs and seeing spikes from 12:02:03 UTC.
Devon Park: pinging in — I'm available to help with traffic steering/failover.
Olivia Chen: plan: 1) enable fallback routing to dedicated read-only cluster, 2) scale instance group for Lucent pool, 3) gather customer impact list and prepare status updates. Assigning tasks.
Marta Ruiz: CS: I need an impact summary and who to notify at Lucent. I have contacts: hannah@lucent.com (primary CSM), rajesh.lucent@lucent.com (infra lead).
Olivia Chen: noted. Impact: intermittent API 5xx and increased latency for Lucent tenants: lucent-payments-prod, lucent-analytics-prod. Estimated affected % of requests: ~18% of their traffic. Time window started ~12:02 UTC.
Devon Park: diagnostic: upstream mesh is returning 502 from a subset of nodes. Running quick health-checks on the Lucent pool: `kubectl -n redwood get pods -l pool=lucent-prod -o wide` shows 2/8 pods reporting CrashLoopBackOff.
Devon Park: trying a rolling restart on the problematic nodes and temporarily removing them from LB: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/lucent-inference --namespace=redwood`
Olivia Chen: doing traffic steering: bumped priority to fallback cluster and enabled prefix cache override for lucent-payments-prod. Monitoring for error rate drop.
Eng Manager (Sam): draft a concise status page update and a customer-facing note. Keep it explicit about impact and ETA.
Olivia Chen: status page draft (for ops review):
```
Status: Partial outage affecting Lucent Financial private deployment in us-west-2
Impact: Some API calls for lucent-payments-prod and lucent-analytics-prod may return 5xx or experience increased latency.
Detected: 2026-03-17 12:02 UTC
Current status: Mitigation in progress — traffic routing to fallback cluster and pod restarts underway.
Next update: 12:20 UTC or earlier if status changes.
Action being taken: Rolling restarts of impacted pods, temporary failover to dedicated fallback cluster, monitoring recovery.
```
CS Lead (Hannah): customer email template ok to use? Need explicit list of affected services and who to CC. Also please include whether data exposure/consistency risk exists.
Olivia Chen: template for Lucent (tailored):
```
Hi Hannah / Rajesh,
We detected an issue at 12:02 UTC impacting Lucent Financial's private deployment in us-west-2. Symptoms: intermittent 5xx responses and elevated latency for: lucent-payments-prod, lucent-analytics-prod.
What we're doing: redirecting traffic to a fallback cluster, restarting affected pods, and monitoring.
Customer impact: some API requests may have failed or taken longer. No evidence of data loss or cross-tenant data exposure.
ETA: expect majority recovery within 20–30 minutes; we will update by 12:20 UTC.
Regards,
Redwood Ops
```
Devon Park: rolling restart finished on 3 nodes, error rate dropping from 18% -> 6% over last 3 minutes. Continuing to iterate.
PagerDuty: Incident PD-7892 status updated: acknowledged -> investigating.
Marta Ruiz: forwarding the tailored note to Lucent contacts now. CCing Eng Manager (Sam) and Olivia.
Olivia Chen: monitoring shows errors at 2.1% now, tail latency back to baseline. Leaving fallback in place for 10 more minutes.
Eng Manager (Sam): good. Prepare internal postmortem skeleton and set on-call handoff notes.
Olivia Chen: on-call handoff in 30m — I'm handing to Devon at 12:40 UTC if still stable. Will document mitigation steps in incident timeline.
CS Lead (Hannah): Lucent confirmed receipt and appreciated quick update; they asked to be kept in loop for ETA and final RCA.
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error rate reduced to baseline. Mitigations remain active. Will close incident after 30m of stable metrics.
Olivia Chen: final note before handing off: cause likely node-level resource exhaustion leading to mesh 502s. Action items: 1) investigate memory/oom patterns on lucent pool nodes, 2) add health-check backoff to avoid cascading restarts, 3) coordinate permanent capacity increase for Lucent pool.
Devon Park: taking over on-call at 12:40 UTC for post-incident checks.
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: PD-7892 resolved at 12:46 UTC. Final status: recovery confirmed; customer notified; follow-up RCA to be scheduled. :white_check_mark:
